components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is prefixed, followed by a single space, to the
            owner's last name to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form); when the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they are preferred.
            On create the returned value is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. When only the flat form is
            supplied it is the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid when it supplies an
            address in EITHER form — a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address'. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) and same postcode — to be created as a declared
            household member instead of being rejected with a 409. A declared member
            is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the household
            link: the householdId is deterministic, so co-resident owners share it
            automatically.
          type: boolean
          example: true

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

                the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. There are no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true

                contained in the customerCode.

              format: int32

              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous year's.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last
                name is compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace. Every owner
                carries one, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

              description: >-

              type: string

              readOnly: true

                add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year (more than one
                elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate).
              type: integer

              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: boolean

## Summary

I implemented the `capacityWarning` flag following the existing `bulkSignupWarning` pattern. When an owner is created, the flag is set `true` if the owner's city already holds 40–49 owners (approaching the hard limit of 50), and persisted so it's returned on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

2. **`AssignOwnerCapacityWarning.java`** (new function) — counts existing owners in the owner's city (case-insensitive, matching `RequireCityCapacity`) and sets `capacityWarning = (count >= 40 && count < 50)`. It runs before `SaveOwner`, so the count reflects existing owners only.

3. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `capacityWarning` step into the create pipeline (after `bulkSignupWarning`, before `possibleDuplicate`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`).

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `capacityWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it (MapStruct auto-maps it by name).

5. **DB schemas** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `capacity_warning BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE` column.
